verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a package manager/CLI for installing and syncing 'skill' definitions (SKILL.md files) into various AI coding agents' directories — it manages skill content, not autonomous scheduling, triggers, or background execution of agent tasks. The evidence pack shows only install/list/update/remove/search commands for skill packages, nothing about running unattended background jobs or automations, so this is a wrong-axis question for this product category.
